scope: Collaboration renderer, browser/mobile cloud bridge, credential entry and account conversion client

rendererIntegration.externalIO: Actual cloud IPC handler, encryption, private local copies and temporary loopback HTTP cloud server; only OS UI surfaces and an explicit network-failure response are substituted
coverage: Login gates for share/device/tag/team entry points
Share create and full-fragment-link accept, local copy open, explicit synchronization, optimistic version conflict and revoke
Device register/rename persistence and current-device revoke clearing the session
Tag CRUD, assignment/filter, tagged folder browsing, persistence and file retention after tag removal
Team viewer UI restrictions, server rejection following role downgrade, owner folder create/rename and persistence
Fragment secret cleared from the address bar, wrong-account import failure preserving current documents, successful invite consumption
Visible read-failure feedback and recovery using the actual server
Existing cloud browser, navigation and conversion-settings regressions

accountConversionClient.externalIO: Actual HTTP account gateway and managed converter protocol with a deterministic injected engine
coverage: Manual token configuration precedence and encrypted local storage
accountConversionClient.limitation: This protocol test does not validate LibreOffice document-format fidelity

productionBrowser.externalIO: Production browser bundle with no Electron preload, same-origin /api proxy to a temporary real cloud server and independent test accounts
productionBrowser.csp: Same strict script-src self policy as mobile/deploy/nginx.conf.example; no unsafe-eval allowance
coverage: Hash team invite confirmation with secret excluded from HTTP request URLs
Private share/team download copied into writable application document storage
Local copy save does not silently overwrite team cloud content
Share/device/tag/team navigation at all three widths
No horizontal page overflow or browser console errors
productionBrowser.releaseBoundary: A local production build was verified. Final combined release build and deployed public-origin acceptance remain with the parent release task.

limitations: Collaboration uses explicit save-then-sync with optimistic cloud versions; simultaneous realtime co-editing and automatic merge are not implemented.
Generated invitation credentials and fragment links are copied only by the user; no SMS, email or messaging invitation is sent by this UI.
Read access controls future cloud requests. An already downloaded offline copy cannot be remotely withdrawn.
Synchronization bindings are established when opening a share/team copy from these pages; after an application restart, reopen through the corresponding page to establish its cloud binding again.
Android and HarmonyOS physical-device behavior is not certified by these browser checks.
This work implements the listed general collaboration features and does not claim complete WPS feature parity.
